## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d82ca533ad474071d25e6ba22d9cf0fa6c695879`
Local-runs: probe — the seat ran the branch's own self-tests from a `git archive` copy of the head (no checkout, no edit, no network) to confirm the dev's counts: `record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` 254 cases, `mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` 45 cases in 8 batteries, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` 401 cases, all exit 0; the ratchet and id-lint were not runnable from the archive (no `.git`, no `skills/`) and are read off the head's check-runs instead
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (L74), references/project-forms.md (〈信箱 PR〉 and the ten paid lines), references/seat-lifecycle.md (two lines), references/execution-duties.md (one line in, one out), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs + .github/workflows/stale.yml (`exempt-pr-labels`, read), card #27077 sections A–E and triage's first grade 6461033102

Read at 2026-10-28T08:18Z by the `domain:skills#2` seat on the fetched head (merge-base `07d18e69`): eight files, +331/−46, 377 changed lines ≤ 3000. Tier S (`.claude/**` + non-gate `scripts/pm/**`; `check-governed-merges --pr 27143` lists the four `.claude` paths and no Tier H path). The model tier for this surface is the ceiling tier (`dispatch-gates --tier`: MANDATORY by `SKILL.md`), and this review is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Sections A–E of the card land where the claim said, in place: 〈信箱 PR〉 is one mailbox PR per seat (`pm:mailbox`+`pinned`, first line `To: <login>`, opened at seating by `mailbox-open.mjs`, closed at hand-over or account switch with the successor opening a new one); the seven first-line keys are spelled as the card prints them (three `Request:`, four `Notify:`), each with from → to and when; the four anti-chatter rules are there (one event one line ≤200 bytes keys-and-numbers; no acknowledgements or re-sends; ≤5 per seat per round with p0 exempt, counted against the write pace; a mailbox comment is a colleague's statement, never an authorisation, pointing at `untrusted-text.md`); E's prohibition (⛔ no gate, workflow or queue guard reads a mailbox) is the section's last line. Triage's ⚠️ (keep the vocabulary CLOSED) holds: seven keys in the text, seven in `MAILBOX_KEYS`, and the reader refuses an eighth by construction.
- SKILL.md L74 now reads 「分诊席与车道席常驻,断粮即换账号重开该席与信箱;分诊席默认判断档;裁决归总监席。」 (116 B) — the maintainer's own words 「分诊席 和每个车道通常是长期开着的,只有账户没token了,会切换账户重开」 in the protocol's register; 裁决归总监席 kept; the retired clause (summoned-not-resident) contradicted those words and is gone. Outside the governed-prose and frame-sync regions (the frame at L242–262 is byte-identical; `check:skill-frame-sync` green in the dev's run).
- Line budget, measured on the head: SKILL.md 319/319, project-forms 54/54, seat-lifecycle 96/96, execution-duties 188/188 (headroom 0 all four, as before); every new prose line ≤120 bytes (`wc -c` on the fourteen 〈信箱 PR〉 lines: 107 … 120); the ten paid lines in project-forms, two in seat-lifecycle and one in execution-duties each name a home, and the seat spot-read six of those homes on the head (SKILL.md L93, lanes/triage.md L4, coordinator.md L23, lanes/director.md L82, seat-post-protocol.md L27/L33, execution-duties.md L83–86) — present. No re-wrap used as currency: each paid line is a deletion of content with a home.
- `record-recognisers.mjs`: `MAILBOX_KEYS` (template + one pure reader per key), `readMailboxLine` (first line only; refuses a second line, a key outside the table, >200 bytes), `mailboxEvents` (rows → events + `halfStates`), exported beside `contractReviewHandoff`; a 21-case doorbell battery (seven accepts, refusals, and a verbatim pin of each template against 〈信箱 PR〉), `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 13 → 14. The template pin reads a governed file in a self-test, which `check:pm-dispatch-gates` requires to be DECLARED — hence the three companion edits below. Correct, and the right shape (text and reader cannot drift apart silently).
- `mailbox-open.mjs`: `pinned` joins `PR_LABELS` (`STALE_EXEMPT_LABEL`, read off `stale.yml`'s `exempt-pr-labels` by a new pin; `pm:mailbox` is confirmed NOT exempt), the body opens with `To: <login>` (the protocol's spelling since the mailbox's birth; the tool's `Mailbox-of:` dialect retired, no stored instance carries it — 0 `pm:mailbox` PRs open, read in this act), the body names the closed vocabulary; refusal ① unchanged because per-login = per-seat (a login holds one seat at a time — the seat's own roster agrees). The open-plan battery 8 → 9, two new pins. Correct.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: protocol text and PM scripts; no package touched. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body match the claim; no `Skills-docs:` line owed. `skip-changeset` correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- File surface breached by three mechanical companion edits, accepted under the bounded in-place rule (the gate's own remedy for this diff; form pinned by the gate's failure text; no open PR holds either file — the dev's scan of 32 open PRs, and the seat's hot-file queue names none; the family `check:pm-dispatch-gates` was already derived for the card): the `self-test-reads` declaration line in `record-recognisers.mjs` (L77), the fifth `GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` row (`declared: true`) in `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` with its docblock, and the ninth live-declaration roster row in `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` (eight → nine, the length pin moved with it). Measured by the dev: 2 of 1935 red before, 1935 pass after. The seat amends the claim's file surface by this record.
- The `pinned` label does not exist on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` (`GET /labels/pinned` → 404 in this act; `work-in-progress` 404; `security` 200), while `stale.yml`'s `exempt-pr-labels` names all three and this PR's text makes `pinned` mandatory on a mailbox. Whether the relay's labels leg creates a missing label is a platform reading the first mailbox open takes; the designed place to create a label the fleet relies on is `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`. Class b (the exemption is dead for two of its three names until the labels exist) — filed by the seat as a separate `finding` card, see the ACCEPT; not widened into this PR.
- `check-half-states.mjs` gained no row: the card's 「表外即半态」 is the reading `mailboxEvents(rows).halfStates` returns; E forbids a gate reading a mailbox, and the half-state patrol is report-only, so adding its row is a later, separate decision — noted, not owed here.
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` NOT MEASURED locally (two packages unbuilt in the dev's worktree; the gate's subject is unrelated); CI's Lint lane builds and runs it — read off the head's check-runs in the ACCEPT.
- Hot files: #27082 (SKILL.md L161/L162/L183) and #26749 (SKILL.md L166, execution-duties L175) are region-disjoint from L74 / execution-duties L37 and L54 — confirmed on the head after the dev's merge of `origin/main` `07d18e69`; #27113 and #27062 share `record-recognisers.mjs` and are serialized behind this PR on the seat post (r70).
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; the PR is draft, no flip by anyone yet.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the maintainer's words (「车道之间可以互通」 but 「避免 ai 互聊信息太多爆炸…只沟通必要的信息」, seats long-lived and re-opened on an account switch): the design gives every seat a doorbell that wakes a session (a PR comment), restricts what can be rung to seven typed one-liners, forbids acknowledgements and re-sends, caps the rate, and keeps the mailbox out of every gate and ledger — the push channel the maintainer asked for with the chatter structurally impossible rather than discouraged. The reader lives in the one recogniser module the fleet already uses and pins the text, so the vocabulary cannot widen in code without failing a self-test. Against the four-axis frame: focus (closed set, no eighth key), AI-error (refusal over tolerance), long-run (one protocol file, one reader). Holds. Residual: the first mailbox open is the end-to-end measurement of the labels leg with a non-existent `pinned`; the filed card removes that unknown before any seat relies on the stale exemption.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27077-mailbox-per-seat-doorbell`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 — 席位终稿 · PR #27143 · head `d82ca533` · `domain:skills#2` · 2026-10-28T08:22Z

- 改了什么:信箱 PR 从「每项目一个」改为「每席一个」(`pm:mailbox`+`pinned`,正文首行 `To: <login>`,坐席即开、交接或换账号关旧开新);信箱评论首行只许七种门铃键(3 种 `Request:`、4 种 `Notify:`),配四条防刷屏硬规则(一事一行 ≤200 字节只写键与编号;无收到/谢谢/催;每席每轮 ≤5 条、p0 豁免;信箱评论永非授权);坐席发 `seat-online`、收班发 `seat-offline`;多席车道按全序交替取卡;SKILL.md L74 改成你说的形态(席位常驻、断粮换账号重开);`record-recognisers.mjs` 读七键并把每个模板逐字钉在协议文本上;`mailbox-open.mjs` 开信箱带 `pinned`、首行写 `To:`。
- 为什么改:你的裁决(「车道之间可以互通」「只沟通必要的信息」「分诊席和每个车道通常是长期开着的」「同意 信箱改每席一张」):只有 PR 评论能唤醒订阅会话,席位之间需要能「推」,但铃声必须是封闭的七种一行式,结构上防 AI 互聊。
- 风险与回滚:纯协议文本 + 两个 PM 脚本,不碰产品包、门禁、workflow、队列守卫;四个受管文件行数上限不变(319/54/96/188,headroom 0),付行均为有家可归的删行(PR 正文逐行列出家)。回滚 = revert。一处已知缺口:`pinned` 标签本仓不存在(404),首次开信箱是第一次实测 —— 已立 #27151 让 `ensure-pm-labels.sh` 建它。
- 先看:① `references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉的七键与四规则;② SKILL.md L74 新句;③ `record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `readMailboxLine` 拒收面。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` 预期 `254 cases pass`;`node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` 预期 `45 cases in 8 batteries pass`;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 四文件各 `headroom 0` 绿。
- 需要你做的:无 —— Tier S,席位契约复核 PASS(6464123012)后由席位翻 ready + 挂 auto-merge 入队;若本会话分类器再次拒绝该落地笔(如 #27082),席位停手并报你。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。三处越面(声明行、`GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` 第五行、自测花名册第九行)是门禁对本 diff 的自身处方,席位以本记录修正认领的文件面;dev 对 `mailbox-open.mjs` 的处理(拒收①不改、`To:` 取代工具方言)实测有据。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg` · 2026-10-28T08:22Z

1. 形态:draft → main,首行 `Fixes #27077`,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 行首在;八个文件 +331/−46(377 行 ≤ 3000);assignee os-justin;`skip-changeset` 正确;`documentation`、`size/m` 为他方 bot 所加,不动。
2. 前提实测:席位在取回的 head(merge-base `07d18e69`)上核 —— 四受管文件 319/54/96/188;〈信箱 PR〉十四行各 ≤120 字节;十三条付行之家抽读六处皆在;L74 新句 116 B 含「裁决归总监席」;七键文本与 `MAILBOX_KEYS` 一一对应;`stale.yml` `exempt-pr-labels` 含 `pinned` 不含 `pm:mailbox`;0 个 `pm:mailbox` PR 开着(`Mailbox-of:` 方言无存量)。
3. 门禁 check-runs(head `d82ca533`,本笔读数 2026-10-28T08:22Z):45 check-runs,26 success · 19 skipped · 0 in progress · 0 failure(`mergeable_state: clean draft`)。dev 本地派生 41 族:40 run exit 0、1 NOT-MEASURED(`check:doc-formula-expressions`,前置包未建,CI 已跑);席位从归档副本复跑三项自测 254/45/401 皆 exit 0。
4. 接受的偏差:① 文件面越界三处机械伴随改动(`record-recognisers.mjs` L77 声明行、`dispatch-gates.data.mjs` 第五行 `declared: true`、`dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` 花名册八→九),门禁自身处方、无其它 open PR 持有这两个文件;② `mailbox-open.mjs` 为 A 的裁定形态而改(非为拒收①);③ `check-half-states.mjs` 未加行(E 禁门禁读信箱,半态读数由 `mailboxEvents().halfStates` 提供);④ seat-online/offline 的「何时」落在 seat-lifecycle.md 两行而非表内(120 字节上限)。
5. 范围外去向:filed #27151(`pinned` 标签 404,`ensure-pm-labels.sh` 建之;`finding`+`tooling`,待分诊定级);Acceptance notes:#27062/#27047 与本 PR 共用 `record-recognisers.mjs`,后落者先合 `origin/main`(已在座位贴 r70 热文件队列)。`Skills-docs:` 不欠(kind none)。
6. 落地条款:Tier S;契约复核 PASS 评论 6464123012(head `d82ca533`);全绿即席位经中继 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` 落地(分类器若拒即停并报维护者,记卡);MERGED 后关卡摘 `pm:dispatched`,随后派发 #27113。
